product_metadata.title: IMUSA USA Traditional Colombian Natural Caldero Glass Lid & Steam Vent 3-Piece (1.4/3.4/6.6) Quart, Silver (Dutch Oven Set)
features: Made of Cast Aluminum in COLOMBIA
Includes 3 Different Sizes 1. 4Qt, 3. 4Qt, & 6. 6Qt Capacity with Traditional Natural Finish that ‘seasons’ over time
Tight Fitting Glass Lid with Steam Vent
Ideal for Rice, Beans, Braise Meat, Simmer Stews, Soups and More
description: Cook your favorite meals using this three-piece set of Calderos. The set includes a small, medium and large Caldero, all with tight-fitting lids. Made of cast aluminum, each pot is easy to wash by hand. Calderos are the ‘workhorse’ of any Hispanic kitchen due to its versatility and unique design. The Caldero (or ‘Cauldron’ in English) has rounded sides, a tight fitting lid, and superior heat distribution. Calderos are used to cook rice, beans, braise meat, and simmer stews and soups.
